shloka_text: अथ राजन्महाबाहुर्विचरन्स महीतले । हिमवद्वनमासाद्य परिचक्राम रावणः ।। 7.17.1 ।।
transliteration: atha rājanmahābāhurvicaransa mahītale | himavadvanamāsādya paricakrāma rāvaṇaḥ || 7.17.1 ||
translation: अथ then, राजन् O King, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, विचरण्स wandering, महीतले on the earth, हिमवद्वनम् the forest of the Himalayas, आसाद्य reaching, परिचक्राम roamed, रावणः Ravana.
explanation: Then, O King, the mighty-armed Ravana, wandering on the earth, reached the Himalayan forest and roamed there.
comments: Ravana finds the ascetic maiden Vedavati, daughter of the brahmin Kushadhvaja, who is vowed to win Vishnu as her husband -- when Ravana woos her and insults her by seizing her hair, she shears it off, enters the fire, and curses that she will be reborn for his destruction -- Agastya reveals that she was reborn as Sita, sprung from the furrow, to bring about Ravana's death.

shloka_text: तत्रापश्यत्स वै कन्यां कृष्णाजिनजटाधराम् । आर्षेण विधिना युक्तां दीप्यन्तीं देवतामिव ।। 7.17.2 ।।
transliteration: tatrāpaśyatsa vai kanyāṃ kṛṣṇājinajaṭādharām | ārṣeṇa vidhinā yuktāṃ dīpyantīṃ devatāmiva || 7.17.2 ||
translation: तत्र there, अपश्यत् he saw, स he, वै indeed, कन्याम् a maiden, कृष्णाजिनजटाधराम् wearing a black deer-skin and matted hair, आर्षेण ascetic's, विधिना practice, युक्ताम् engaged in, दीप्यन्तीम् shining, देवतामिव like a goddess.
explanation: There he indeed saw a maiden, wearing a black deer-skin and matted hair, engaged in ascetic practices, shining like a goddess.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा रूपसम्पन्नां कन्यां तां सुमहाव्रताम् । काममोहपरीतात्मा पप्रच्छ प्रहसन्निव ।। 7.17.3 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā rūpasampannāṃ kanyāṃ tāṃ sumahāvratām | kāmamohaparītātmā papraccha prahasanniva || 7.17.3 ||
translation: स he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रूपसम्पन्नाम् endowed with beauty, कन्याम् maiden, ताम् that, सुमहाव्रताम् observing great vows, काममोहपरीतात्मा whose mind was overcome by the delusion of desire, पप्रच्छ he asked, प्रहसन्निव as if laughing.
explanation: Having seen that beautiful maiden observing great vows, he, whose mind was overcome by the delusion of desire, asked her as if with a smile.

shloka_text: किमिदं वर्तसे भद्रे विरुद्धं यौवनस्य ते । नहि युक्ता तवैतस्य रूपस्यैव प्रतिक्रिया ।। 7.17.4 ।।
transliteration: kimidaṃ vartase bhadre viruddhaṃ yauvanasya te | nahi yuktā tavaitasya rūpasyaiva pratikriyā || 7.17.4 ||
translation: किम् what, इदम् this, वर्तसे you are doing, भद्रे O auspicious one, विरुद्धम् contrary, यौवनस्य to youth, ते your, नहि indeed not, युक्ता suitable, तव for your, एतस्य this, रूपस्य beauty, एव indeed, प्रतिक्रिया action/conduct
explanation: O gentle lady, what is this conduct of yours, which is contrary to your youth, for such actions are indeed not suitable for your beauty.

shloka_text: रूपं ते ऽनुपमं भीरु कामोन्मादकरं नृणाम् । न युक्तं तपसि स्थातुं निर्गतो ह्येष निर्णयः ।। 7.17.5 ।।
transliteration: rūpaṃ te 'nupamaṃ bhīru kāmonmādakaraṃ nṛṇām | na yuktaṃ tapasi sthātuṃ nirgato hyeṣa nirṇayaḥ || 7.17.5 ||
translation: रूपम् beauty, ते your, अनुपमम् incomparable, भीरु O timid one, कामोन्मादकरम् causing infatuation of desire, नृणाम् for men, न not, युक्तम् suitable, तपसि in penance, स्थातुम् to stay, निर्गतः has come out/is established, हि indeed, एषः this, निर्णयः conclusion
explanation: O timid one, your incomparable beauty, which incites desire and madness in men, is not suitable for ascetic practices, for this is indeed a well-established conclusion.

shloka_text: कस्यासि किमिदं भद्रे कश्च भर्ता वरानने । येन सम्भुज्यसे भीरु स नरः पुण्यभाग्भुवि ।। 7.17.6 ।।
transliteration: kasyāsi kimidaṃ bhadre kaśca bhartā varānane | yena sambhujyase bhīru sa naraḥ puṇyabhāgbhuvi || 7.17.6 ||
translation: कस्याः whose, असि you are, किम् what, इदम् this (activity), भद्रे O gentle lady, कः who, च and, भर्ता husband, वरानने O beautiful-faced one, येन by whom, सम्भुज्यसे you are enjoyed/possessed, भीरु O timid one, सः that, नरः man, पुण्यभाक् fortunate, भुवि on earth
explanation: O gentle lady, whose are you, and what is this activity; O beautiful-faced one, who is your husband, for the man by whom you are enjoyed, O timid one, is indeed fortunate on this earth.

shloka_text: पृच्छतः शंस मे सर्वं कस्य हेतोः परिश्रमः । एवमुक्ता तु सा कन्या रावणेन यशस्विनी ।। 7.17.7 ।।
transliteration: pṛcchataḥ śaṃsa me sarvaṃ kasya hetoḥ pariśramaḥ | evamuktā tu sā kanyā rāvaṇena yaśasvinī || 7.17.7 ||
translation: पृच्छतः to me who asks, शंस tell, मे me, सर्वम् everything, कस्य for what, हेतोः reason, परिश्रमः effort/exertion (here, penance), एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, तु then, सा that, कन्या maiden, रावणेन by Ravana, यशस्विनी glorious
explanation: Tell me everything, who am asking, for what reason is this exertion; thus spoken to by Ravana, that glorious maiden then replied.

shloka_text: कुशध्वजो मम पिता ब्रह्मर्षिरमितप्रभः । बृहस्पतिसुतः श्रीमान्बुद्ध्या तुल्यो बृहस्पतेः ।। 7.17.8 ।।
transliteration: kuśadhvajo mama pitā brahmarṣiramitaprabhaḥ | bṛhaspatisutaḥ śrīmānbuddhyā tulyo bṛhaspateḥ || 7.17.8 ||
translation: कुशध्वजः Kushadhvaja, मम my, पिता father, ब्रह्मर्षिः a Brahmarshi, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, बृहस्पतिसुतः son of Brihaspati, श्रीमान् glorious, बुद्ध्या in intellect, तुल्यः equal, बृहस्पतेः to Brihaspati
explanation: My father is Kushadhvaja, a Brahmarshi of immeasurable splendor, the glorious son of Brihaspati, and equal to Brihaspati in intellect.

shloka_text: तस्याहं कुर्वतो नित्यं वेदाभ्यासं महात्मनः । सम्भूय वाङ्मयी कन्या नाम्ना वेदवती स्मृता ।। 7.17.9 ।।
transliteration: tasyāhaṃ kurvato nityaṃ vedābhyāsaṃ mahātmanaḥ | sambhūya vāṅmayī kanyā nāmnā vedavatī smṛtā || 7.17.9 ||
translation: तस्य his, अहं I, कुर्वतः while performing, नित्यं constantly, वेदाभ्यासं study of Vedas, महात्मनः of the great soul, सम्भूय having been born, वाङ्मयी consisting of speech, कन्या a daughter, नाम्ना by name, वेदवती Vedavati, स्मृता was known.
explanation: While my great-souled father was constantly engaged in the study of the Vedas, I was born as a daughter, manifested from his speech, and was known by the name Vedavati.

shloka_text: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः । ते ऽपि गत्वा हि पितरं वरणं रोचयन्ति मे ।। 7.17.10 ।।
transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ | te 'pi gatvā hi pitaraṃ varaṇaṃ rocayanti me || 7.17.10 ||
translation: ततः then, देवाः gods, सगन्धर्वाः along with Gandharvas, यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः Yakshas, Rakshasas, and Pannagas, ते they, अपि also, गत्वा having gone, हि indeed, पितरं to my father, वरणं a marriage proposal, रोचयन्ति desired, मे for me.
explanation: Then, gods along with Gandharvas, Yakshas, Rakshasas, and Pannagas, all went to my father and sought my hand in marriage.

shloka_text: न च मां स पिता तेभ्यो दत्तवान्राक्षसर्षभ । कारणं तद्वदिष्यामि निशाचर निशामय ।। 7.17.11 ।।
transliteration: na ca māṃ sa pitā tebhyo dattavānrākṣasarṣabha | kāraṇaṃ tadvadiṣyāmi niśācara niśāmaya || 7.17.11 ||
translation: न not, च and, मां me, सः that, पिता father, तेभ्यः to them, दत्तवान् gave, राक्षसर्षभ O best of Rakshasas, कारणं the reason, तत् that, वदिष्यामि I will tell, निशाचर O night-wanderer, निशामय listen.
explanation: But that father of mine did not give me to them, O best of Rakshasas; I will now tell you the reason for that, O night-wanderer, so listen.

shloka_text: पितुस्तु मम जामाता विष्णुः किल सुरेश्वरः । अभिप्रेतस्त्रिलोकेशस्तस्मान्नान्यस्य मे पिता ।। 7.17.12 ।।
transliteration: pitustu mama jāmātā viṣṇuḥ kila sureśvaraḥ | abhipretastrilokeśastasmānnānyasya me pitā || 7.17.12 ||
translation: पितुः of my father, तु indeed, मम my, जामाता son-in-law, विष्णुः Vishnu, किल it is said, सुरेश्वरः the lord of gods, अभिप्रेतः desired, त्रिलोकेशः the lord of the three worlds, तस्मात् therefore, न not, अन्यस्य to another, मे my, पिता father (gave me).
explanation: My father indeed desired Vishnu, the lord of gods and the lord of the three worlds, to be his son-in-law, and therefore he would not give me to anyone else.

shloka_text: दातुमिच्छति तस्मै तु तच्छ्रुत्वा बलदर्पितः । दम्भुर्नाम ततो राजा दैत्यानां कुपितो ऽभवत् ।। 7.17.13 ।।
transliteration: dātumicchati tasmai tu tacchrutvā baladarpitaḥ | dambhurnāma tato rājā daityānāṃ kupito 'bhavat || 7.17.13 ||
translation: दातुम् to give, इच्छति desired, तस्मै to him, तु but, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, बलदर्पितः proud of his strength, दम्भुः Dambhu, नाम named, ततः then, राजा king, दैत्यानां of the Daityas, कुपितः enraged, अभवत् became.
explanation: But upon hearing that my father desired to give me to Vishnu, the king of Daityas named Dambhu, who was proud of his strength, became enraged.

transliteration: tena rātrau śayāno me pitā pāpena hiṃsitaḥ || 7.17.14 ||
translation: तेन by him, रात्रौ at night, शयानः sleeping, मे my, पिता father, पापेन by the wicked one, हिंसितः was killed.
explanation: My father, while sleeping at night, was killed by that wicked one.

shloka_text: ततो मे जननी दीना तच्छरीरं पितुर्मम । परिष्वज्य महाभागा प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहनम् ।। 7.17.15 ।।
transliteration: tato me jananī dīnā taccharīraṃ piturmama | pariṣvajya mahābhāgā praviṣṭā havyavāhanam || 7.17.15 ||
translation: ततः then, मे my, जननी mother, दीना distressed, तत् that, शरीरम् body, पितुः of father, मम my, परिष्वज्य embracing, महाभागा the noble lady, प्रविष्टा entered, हव्यवाहनम् the fire.
explanation: Then, my distressed mother, that noble lady, embraced my father's body and entered the fire.

shloka_text: ततो मनोरथं सत्यं पितुर्नारायणं प्रति । करोमीति तमेवाहं हृदयेन समुद्वहे ।। 7.17.16 ।।
transliteration: tato manorathaṃ satyaṃ piturnārāyaṇaṃ prati | karomīti tamevāhaṃ hṛdayena samudvahe || 7.17.16 ||
translation: ततः then, मनोरथम् the desire, सत्यम् true, पितुः of my father, नारायणम् Narayana, प्रति towards, करोमि I will fulfill, इति thus, तम् that (desire), एव indeed, अहम् I, हृदयेन with my heart, समुद्वहे bear.
explanation: Then, I bear in my heart the true desire of my father towards Narayana, vowing to fulfill it.

shloka_text: इति प्रतिज्ञामारुह्य चरामि विपुलं तपः । एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं मया राक्षसपुङ्गव ।। 7.17.17 ।।
transliteration: iti pratijñāmāruhya carāmi vipulaṃ tapaḥ | etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā rākṣasapuṅgava || 7.17.17 ||
translation: इति thus, प्रतिज्ञाम् a vow, आरुह्य having undertaken, चरामि I perform, विपुलम् great, तपः austerity, एतत् this, ते to you, सर्वम् all, आख्यातम् has been told, मया by me, राक्षसपुङ्गव O best of Rakshasas.
explanation: Thus, having undertaken this vow, I perform great austerity, and all this has been told to you by me, O best of Rakshasas.

shloka_text: नारायणो मम पतिर्न त्वन्यः पुरुषोत्तमात् । आश्रये नियमं घोरं नारायणपरीप्सया । विज्ञातस्त्वं हि मे राजन्गच्छ पौलस्त्यनन्दन ।। 7.17.18 ।।
transliteration: nārāyaṇo mama patirna tvanyaḥ puruṣottamāt | āśraye niyamaṃ ghoraṃ nārāyaṇaparīpsayā | vijñātastvaṃ hi me rājangaccha paulastyanandana || 7.17.18 ||
translation: नारायणः Narayana, मम my, पतिः husband, न not, तु indeed, अन्यः another, पुरुषोत्तमात् than Purushottama, आश्रये I undertake, नियमम् a vow, घोरम् severe, नारायणपरीप्सया with the desire to obtain Narayana, विज्ञातः known, त्वम् you, हि indeed, मे to me, राजन् O king, गच्छ go, पौलस्त्यनन्दन O delight of Pulastya.
explanation: Narayana is my husband, and no one else is superior to Purushottama; I undertake a severe vow with the desire to obtain Narayana, and now that you are known to me, O king, O delight of Pulastya, you may go.

shloka_text: जानामि तपसा सर्वं त्रैलोक्ये यद्धि वर्तते ।। 7.17.19 ।।
transliteration: jānāmi tapasā sarvaṃ trailokye yaddhi vartate || 7.17.19 ||
translation: जानामि I know, तपसा by asceticism, सर्वम् all, त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, यत् whatever, हि indeed, वर्तते exists.
explanation: I know all that indeed exists in the three worlds through my ascetic power.

shloka_text: सो ऽब्रवीद्रावणो भूयस्तां कन्यां सुमहाव्रताम् । अवरुह्य विमानाग्रात्कन्दर्पशरपीडितः ।। 7.17.20 ।।
transliteration: so 'bravīdrāvaṇo bhūyastāṃ kanyāṃ sumahāvratām | avaruhya vimānāgrātkandarpaśarapīḍitaḥ || 7.17.20 ||
translation: सः He, अब्रवीत् spoke, रावणः Ravana, भूयः again, ताम् to that, कन्याम् maiden, सुमहाव्रताम् of great vows, अवरुह्य having descended, विमानाग्रात् from the top of the aerial car, कन्दर्पशरपीडितः afflicted by the arrows of Kama (god of love).
explanation: Afflicted by the arrows of Kama, Ravana descended from the top of his aerial car and spoke again to that maiden of great vows.

shloka_text: अवलिप्ता ऽसि सुश्रोणि यस्यास्ते मतिरीदृशी । वृद्धानां मृगशावाक्षि भ्राजते पुण्यसञ्चयः ।। 7.17.21 ।।
transliteration: avaliptā 'si suśroṇi yasyāste matirīdṛśī | vṛddhānāṃ mṛgaśāvākṣi bhrājate puṇyasañcayaḥ || 7.17.21 ||
translation: अवलिप्ता arrogant, असि you are, सुश्रोणि O beautiful-hipped one, यस्याः whose, ते your, मतिः mind, ईदृशी such, वृद्धानाम् of the old, मृगशावाक्षि O deer-eyed one, भ्राजते shines, पुण्यसञ्चयः accumulation of merit.
explanation: O beautiful-hipped one, you are arrogant to have such a mind; O deer-eyed one, the accumulation of merit shines only for the aged.

shloka_text: त्वं सर्वंगुणसम्पन्ना नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशम् । त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी भीरु यौवनं ते निवर्तते ।। 7.17.22 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ sarvaṃguṇasampannā nārhase vaktumīdṛśam | trailokyasundarī bhīru yauvanaṃ te nivartate || 7.17.22 ||
translation: त्वम् You, सर्वंगुणसम्पन्ना endowed with all virtues, न not, अर्हसे ought, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such (a thing), त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी O most beautiful in the three worlds, भीरु O timid one, यौवनम् youth, ते your, निवर्तते is passing away.
explanation: O most beautiful in the three worlds and O timid one, you who are endowed with all virtues ought not to speak such a thing, for your youth is passing away.

shloka_text: अहं लङ्कापतिर्भद्रे दशग्रीव इति श्रुतः । तस्य मे भव भार्या त्वं भुङ्क्ष्व भोगान्यथासुखम् ।। 7.17.23 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ laṅkāpatirbhadre daśagrīva iti śrutaḥ | tasya me bhava bhāryā tvaṃ bhuṅkṣva bhogānyathāsukham || 7.17.23 ||
translation: अहम् I, लङ्कापतिः lord of Lanka, भद्रे O auspicious one, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, इति thus, श्रुतः known, तस्य his, मे my, भव become, भार्या wife, त्वम् you, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy, भोगान् pleasures, यथासुखम् as you please.
explanation: O auspicious one, I am known as Dashagriva, the lord of Lanka; become my wife and enjoy pleasures as you please.

shloka_text: कश्च तावदसौ यं त्वं विष्णुरित्यभिभाषसे । वीर्येण तपसा चैव भोगेन च बलेन च ।।
transliteration: kaśca tāvadasau yaṃ tvaṃ viṣṇurityabhibhāṣase | vīryeṇa tapasā caiva bhogena ca balena ca ||
translation: कश्च who indeed, तावत् then, असौ that one, यम् whom, त्वम् you, विष्णुः Vishnu, इति thus, अभिभाषसे you speak of, वीर्येण by valor, तपसा by penance, च and, एव indeed, भोगेन by enjoyment, च and, बलेन by strength, च and
explanation: Ravana asks Vedavati who this Vishnu is, whom she speaks of, and what he possesses in terms of valor, penance, enjoyment, and strength.

shloka_text: न मया स समो भद्रे यं त्वं कामयसे ऽङ्गने ।। 7.17.24 ।।
transliteration: na mayā sa samo bhadre yaṃ tvaṃ kāmayase 'ṅgane || 7.17.24 ||
translation: न not, मया with me, सः he, समः equal, भद्रे O auspicious one, यम् whom, त्वम् you, कामयसे desire, अङ्गने O lady
explanation: Ravana declares to Vedavati that the one she desires is not equal to him.

shloka_text: इत्युक्तवति तस्मिंस्तु वेदवत्यथ सा ऽब्रवीत् ।। 7.17.25 ।।
transliteration: ityuktavati tasmiṃstu vedavatyatha sā 'bravīt || 7.17.25 ||
translation: इति thus, उक्तवति having spoken, तस्मिन् when he, तु indeed, वेदवती Vedavati, अथ then, सा she, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: After Ravana had spoken thus, Vedavati then replied to him.

shloka_text: वै भोगेन च बलेन च ।। मा मैवमिति सा कन्या तमुवाच निशाचरम् । त्रैलोक्याधिपति विष्णुं सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम् । त्वदृते राक्षसेन्द्रान्यः को ऽवमन्येत बुद्धिमान् ।। 7.17.26 ।।
transliteration: vai bhogena ca balena ca || mā maivamiti sā kanyā tamuvāca niśācaram | trailokyādhipati viṣṇuṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam | tvadṛte rākṣasendrānyaḥ ko 'vamanyeta buddhimān || 7.17.26 ||
translation: वै indeed, भोगेन by enjoyment, च and, बलेन by strength, च and, मा not, मा not, एवम् thus, इति thus, सा she, कन्या the maiden, तम् to him, उवाच spoke, निशाचरम् to the night-wanderer, त्रैलोक्याधिपतिम् the lord of the three worlds, विष्णुम् Vishnu, सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम् worshipped by all worlds, त्वत् than you, ऋते except, राक्षसेन्द्र O king of Rakshasas, अन्यः another, कः who, अवमन्येत would disrespect, बुद्धिमान् intelligent one
explanation: Vedavati, the maiden, told the night-wanderer Ravana, "No, not so!" and asked, "O king of Rakshasas, who else among intelligent beings, besides you, would disrespect Vishnu, the lord of the three worlds, who is worshipped by all?"

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तया तत्र वेदवत्या निशाचरः । मूर्धजेषु तदा कन्यां कराग्रेण परामृशत् ।। 7.17.27 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastayā tatra vedavatyā niśācaraḥ | mūrdhajeṣu tadā kanyāṃ karāgreṇa parāmṛśat || 7.17.27 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, तया by her, तत्र there, वेदवत्या by Vedavati, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, मूर्धजेषु on the hair of the head, तदा then, कन्याम् the maiden, कराग्रेण with the tip of his hand, परामृशत् touched
explanation: When Vedavati had spoken thus to him there, the night-wanderer Ravana then touched the maiden's hair with the tip of his hand.

shloka_text: ततो वेदवती क्रुद्धा केशान्हस्तेन सा ऽच्छिनत् । असिर्भूत्वा करस्तस्याः केशांश्छिन्नांस्तदा ऽकरोत् ।। 7.17.28 ।।
transliteration: tato vedavatī kruddhā keśānhastena sā 'cchinat | asirbhūtvā karastasyāḥ keśāṃśchinnāṃstadā 'karot || 7.17.28 ||
translation: ततः then, वेदवती Vedavati, क्रुद्धा enraged, केशान् her hair, हस्तेन with her hand, सा she, अच्छिनत् cut off । असिर्भूत्वा having become a sword, करः the hand, तस्याः her, केशान् hair, छिन्नान् cut off, तदा then, अकरोत् made (it) ।
explanation: Then, enraged Vedavati cut off her hair with her hand, which, having transformed into a sword, severed her locks.

shloka_text: सा ज्वलन्तीव रोषेण दहन्तीव निशाचरम् । उवाचाग्निं समाधाय मरणाय कृतत्वरा ।। 7.17.29 ।।
transliteration: sā jvalantīva roṣeṇa dahantīva niśācaram | uvācāgniṃ samādhāya maraṇāya kṛtatvarā || 7.17.29 ||
translation: सा She, ज्वलन्तीव as if burning, रोषेण with rage, दहन्तीव as if burning, निशाचरम् the night-wanderer (Ravana), उवाच spoke, अग्निम् fire, समाधाय having kindled/meditated upon, मरणाय for death, कृतत्वरा having made haste/resolved ।
explanation: Burning with rage as if to consume the night-wanderer, she, resolved to die, kindled a fire and spoke.

shloka_text: धर्षितायास्त्वयानार्य न मे जीवितमिष्यते । रक्षस्तस्मात्प्रवेक्ष्यामि पश्यतस्ते हुताशनम् ।। 7.17.30 ।।
transliteration: dharṣitāyāstvayānārya na me jīvitamiṣyate | rakṣastasmātpravekṣyāmi paśyataste hutāśanam || 7.17.30 ||
translation: धर्षितायाः of me, who has been molested, त्वया by you, अनार्य O ignoble one, न not, मे my, जीवितम् life, इष्यते is desired । रक्षः O Rakshasa, तस्मात् therefore, प्रवेक्ष्यामि I shall enter, पश्यतः while seeing, ते you, हुताशनम् the fire ।
explanation: O ignoble one, since I have been molested by you, I no longer desire to live, O Rakshasa; therefore, I shall enter the fire before your very eyes.

shloka_text: यस्मात्तु धर्षिता चाहं त्वया पापात्मना वने । तस्मात्तव वधार्थं हि समुत्पत्स्ये ह्यहं पुनः ।। 7.17.31 ।।
transliteration: yasmāttu dharṣitā cāhaṃ tvayā pāpātmanā vane | tasmāttava vadhārthaṃ hi samutpatsye hyahaṃ punaḥ || 7.17.31 ||
translation: यस्मात् because, तु indeed, धर्षिता molested, च and, अहम् I, त्वया by you, पापात्मना evil-souled, वने in the forest, तस्मात् therefore, तव your, वधार्थम् for the sake of destruction, हि indeed, समुत्पत्स्ये I shall be born, हि indeed, अहम् I, पुनः again ।
explanation: Because I have been molested by your evil self in this forest, I shall indeed be born again for the sole purpose of your destruction.

shloka_text: न हि शक्यं स्त्रिया हन्तुं पुरुषः पापनिश्चः । शापे त्वयि मयोत्सृष्टे तपसश्च व्ययो भवेत् ।। 7.17.32 ।।
transliteration: na hi śakyaṃ striyā hantuṃ puruṣaḥ pāpaniścaḥ | śāpe tvayi mayotsṛṣṭe tapasaśca vyayo bhavet || 7.17.32 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, शक्यम् possible, स्त्रिया by a woman, हन्तुम् to kill, पुरुषः a man, पापनिश्चयः one whose resolve is evil । शापे if a curse, त्वयि upon you, मया by me, उत्सृष्टे is uttered, तपसः of penance, च and, व्ययः loss, भवेत् would be ।
explanation: Indeed, it is not possible for a woman to kill a man of evil resolve, and if I were to utter a curse upon you, my accumulated penance would be lost.

shloka_text: यदि त्वस्ति मया किञ्चित्कृतं दत्तं हुतं तथा । तस्मात्त्वयोनिजा साध्वी भवेयं धर्मिणः सुता ।। 7.17.33 ।।
transliteration: yadi tvasti mayā kiñcitkṛtaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ tathā | tasmāttvayonijā sādhvī bhaveyaṃ dharmiṇaḥ sutā || 7.17.33 ||
translation: यदि if, तु indeed, अस्ति is, मया by me, किञ्चित् anything, कृतं done, दत्तं given, हुतं offered, तथा and so, तस्मात् therefore, त्वयोनिजा not born from a womb, साध्वी virtuous, भवेयं may I be, धर्मिणः of a righteous man, सुता daughter,
explanation: If I have indeed performed any good deeds, given charity, or offered sacrifices, then may I be born as the virtuous, womb-born daughter of a righteous man.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा प्रविष्टा सा ज्वलितं जातवेदसम् । पपात च दिवो दिव्या पुष्पवृष्टिः समन्ततः ।। 7.17.34 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā praviṣṭā sā jvalitaṃ jātavedasam | papāta ca divo divyā puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ samantataḥ || 7.17.34 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, प्रविष्टा entered, सा she, ज्वलितं blazing, जातवेदसम् fire, पपात fell, च and, दिवो from the sky, दिव्या divine, पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, समन्ततः all around,
explanation: Having spoken thus, she entered the blazing fire, and simultaneously, a divine shower of flowers fell from the sky all around.

shloka_text: पुनरेव समुद्भूता पद्मे पद्मसमप्रभा । तस्मादपि पुनः प्राप्ता पूर्ववत्तेन रक्षसा ।। 7.17.35 ।।
transliteration: punareva samudbhūtā padme padmasamaprabhā | tasmādapi punaḥ prāptā pūrvavattena rakṣasā || 7.17.35 ||
translation: पुनरेव again indeed, समुद्भूता emerged, पद्मे in a lotus, पद्मसमप्रभा having the radiance of a lotus, तस्मादपि from that also, पुनः again, प्राप्ता obtained, पूर्ववत् as before, तेन by that, रक्षसा demon,
explanation: She emerged again from a lotus, radiant like a lotus, and from that lotus, she was again taken by that demon as before.

shloka_text: कन्यां कमलगर्भाभां प्रगृह्य स्वगृहं ययौ । प्रगृह्य रावणस्त्वेतां दर्शयामास मन्त्रिणे ।। 7.17.36 ।।
transliteration: kanyāṃ kamalagarbhābhāṃ pragṛhya svagṛhaṃ yayau | pragṛhya rāvaṇastvetāṃ darśayāmāsa mantriṇe || 7.17.36 ||
translation: कन्यां the maiden, कमलगर्भाभां having the radiance of a lotus's inner part, प्रगृह्य having taken, स्वगृहं to his own house, ययौ went, प्रगृह्य having taken, रावणस्तु but Ravana, एतां her, दर्शयामास showed, मन्त्रिणे to his minister,
explanation: Having seized the maiden, who shone like the heart of a lotus, the demon went to his own house, and Ravana then showed her to his minister.

shloka_text: लक्षणज्ञो निरीक्ष्यैव रावणं चैवमब्रवीत् । गृहस्थैषां हि सुश्रोणी त्वद्वधायैव दृश्यते ।। 7.17.37 ।।
transliteration: lakṣaṇajño nirīkṣyaiva rāvaṇaṃ caivamabravīt | gṛhasthaiṣāṃ hi suśroṇī tvadvadhāyaiva dṛśyate || 7.17.37 ||
translation: लक्षणज्ञो the knower of auspicious marks, निरीक्ष्यैव having seen her indeed, रावणं to Ravana, चैवम् and thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, गृहस्था staying in your house, एषा this one, हि indeed, सुश्रोणी beautiful-hipped, त्वद्वधायैव for your destruction indeed, दृश्यते is seen,
explanation: The physiognomist, having observed her, spoke to Ravana, saying, "This beautiful-hipped maiden, staying in your house, is indeed destined for your destruction."

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा ऽर्णवे राम तां प्रचिक्षेप रावणः । सा चैव क्षितिमासाद्य यज्ञायतनमध्यगा ।। 7.17.38 ।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā 'rṇave rāma tāṃ pracikṣepa rāvaṇaḥ | sā caiva kṣitimāsādya yajñāyatanamadhyagā || 7.17.38 ||
translation: एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, अर्णवे into the water/ocean, राम O Rama, तां her, प्रचिक्षेप threw, रावणः Ravana, सा she, च and, एव indeed, क्षितिम् the earth, आसाद्य having reached, यज्ञायतनमध्यगा went into the middle of a sacrificial ground.
explanation: O Rama, having heard this, Ravana threw her into the water, and she, having reached the earth, indeed went into the middle of a sacrificial ground.

shloka_text: राज्ञो हलमुखोत्कृष्टा पुनरप्युत्थिता सती । सैषा जनकराजस्य प्रसूता तनया प्रभो । तव भार्या महाबाहो विष्णुस्त्वं हि सनातनः ।। 7.17.39 ।।
transliteration: rājño halamukhotkṛṣṭā punarapyutthitā satī | saiṣā janakarājasya prasūtā tanayā prabho | tava bhāryā mahābāho viṣṇustvaṃ hi sanātanaḥ || 7.17.39 ||
translation: राज्ञः of the king, हलमुखोत्कृष्टा drawn out by the ploughshare, पुनरपि again, उत्थिता arisen, सती being, सा she, एषा this, जनकराजस्य of King Janaka, प्रसूता born, तनया daughter, प्रभो O Lord, तव your, भार्या wife, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, विष्णुः Vishnu, त्वं you, हि indeed, सनातनः the eternal one.
explanation: O Lord, O mighty-armed one, she, having again arisen, drawn out by the ploughshare of King Janaka, is this daughter born to King Janaka, your wife, for you are indeed the eternal Vishnu.

shloka_text: पूर्वं क्रोधाहितः शत्रुर्यया ऽसौ निहतस्तथा । उपाश्रयित्वा शैलभस्तव वीर्यममानुषम् ।। 7.17.40 ।।
transliteration: pūrvaṃ krodhāhitaḥ śatruryayā 'sau nihatastathā | upāśrayitvā śailabhastava vīryamamānuṣam || 7.17.40 ||
translation: पूर्वम् previously, क्रोधाहितः filled with anger, शत्रुः the enemy, यया by whom, असौ that, निहतः killed, तथा thus, उपाश्रयित्वा having resorted to, शैलभः mountain-like (Ravana), तव your, वीर्यम् prowess, अमानुषम् superhuman.
explanation: Previously, that mountain-like enemy, filled with anger, was thus killed by her, having resorted to your superhuman prowess.

shloka_text: एवमेषा महाभागा मर्त्येषूत्पत्स्यते पुनः । क्षेत्रे हलमुखोत्कृष्टे वेद्यामग्निशिखोपमा ।। 7.17.41 ।।
transliteration: evameṣā mahābhāgā martyeṣūtpatsyate punaḥ | kṣetre halamukhotkṛṣṭe vedyāmagniśikhopamā || 7.17.41 ||
translation: एवम् thus, एषा this, महाभागा highly fortunate one, मर्त्येषु among mortals, उत्पत्स्यते will be born, पुनः again, क्षेत्रे in the field, हलमुखोत्कृष्टे drawn out by the ploughshare, वेद्याम् on the altar/sacrificial ground, अग्निशिखोपमा like a flame of fire.
explanation: Thus, this highly fortunate one will again be born among mortals, in a field drawn out by the ploughshare, appearing like a flame of fire on the sacrificial ground.

shloka_text: एषा वेदवती नाम पूर्वमासीत्कृते युगे । त्रेतायुगमनुप्राप्य वधार्थं तस्य रक्षसः ।। 7.17.42 ।।
transliteration: eṣā vedavatī nāma pūrvamāsītkṛte yuge | tretāyugamanuprāpya vadhārthaṃ tasya rakṣasaḥ || 7.17.42 ||
translation: एषा this, वेदवती Vedavati, नाम named, पूर्वम् previously, आसीत् was, कृते युगे in the Krita Yuga, त्रेतायुगम् the Treta Yuga, अनुप्राप्य having reached/upon the arrival of, वधार्थम् for the purpose of killing, तस्य that, रक्षसः demon.
explanation: This one, named Vedavati, was previously in the Krita Yuga, and upon the arrival of the Treta Yuga, she appeared for the purpose of killing that demon.

shloka_text: उत्पन्ना मैथिलकुले जनकस्य महात्मनः । सीतोत्पन्ना तु सीतेति मानुषैः पुनरुच्यते ।। 7.17.43 ।।
transliteration: utpannā maithilakule janakasya mahātmanaḥ | sītotpannā tu sīteti mānuṣaiḥ punarucyate || 7.17.43 ||
translation: उत्पन्ना born, मैथिलकुले in the family of the Maithila (king of Mithila), जनकस्य of Janaka, महात्मनः the great-souled, सीतोत्पन्ना born from the furrow, तु indeed, सीतेति as Sita, मानुषैः by humans, पुनरुच्यते is again called.
explanation: She was born in the family of the great-souled Janaka, the king of Mithila, and because she emerged from the furrow, she is known by humans as Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तदशः सर्गः ।। 17 ।। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
